test_case.test_name: Persistent DRAM command/address parity injection — interface and clear path required
test_case.purpose: Inject one persistent parity fault per approved controller with CAP enabled, verify persistent UCE handling and physical indications, then positively clear the condition and recover cleanly.
required_package: Approved package build/hash, namespace and valid fully named injectCMDParityPersistent signature
Backup, independent console, recovery and BIOS restoration plan
test_case.test_command: NO INJECTION AUTHORIZED. Do not run or silently repair `ei.injectCMDParityPersistent(socket, hbm=-1, mc, channel)`. The Intel/FAE must first provide the exact valid call and proven persistence-clear sequence for this package; a new review-layer revision will then bind one target and the complete lifecycle.
test_case.expected_result: Once approved, each target must show persistence-specific Cscript success and signed UCE/indicator behavior, followed by an auditable clear operation, healthy boot/runtime, no residual repeated error and restored BIOS/CAP state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS exists without valid syntax and a proven clear path. Syntax failure, borrowed transient interface, generic parity/UCE text, inability to clear, crash loop, wrong target/indicator, residual error or incomplete restoration is not PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT, stable power, independent console and qualified FAE.
Arm and verify the vendor clear/recovery path before any persistent injection.
One approved target only; stop on wrong severity, error storm, data concern, no-boot or clear failure.
No autonomous clearing, reset, power cycle or automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Approved package/runbook, exact valid persistent call and clear sequence
Full Cscript persistence success plus Windows/BMC/UEFI/indicator evidence
test_case.recovery: Not executable until the vendor specifies the clear path. The eventual approved procedure must preserve evidence, positively clear persistent state, recover through the independent console and verify clean CAP/BIOS/health before any rerun.
